chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: Gserver Userbot IPC and Google Drive storage preflight

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
printf 'USERBOT_SERVICE_ACTIVE='
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_SERVICE_ENABLED='
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'OWNER_REPO_HEAD='
git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'OWNER_IPC_FILENAMES:\n'
find "$P" -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname '*userbot*' -o -iname '*ipc*' \) -printf '%P\n' 2>/dev/null | head -35 || true
printf 'USERBOT_SOCKETS:\n'
find /run/user/"$(id -u)" -maxdepth 4 -type s -name '*userbot*' -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -12 || true
printf 'GD_RCLONE_INSTALLED='
command -v rclone >/dev/null && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'GD_CREDENTIAL_FILE_PRESENCE='
test -f "$HOME/.config/rclone/rclone.conf" && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'GD_MOUNT_POINTS:\n'
mount | grep -Ei 'drive|rclone' | sed -E 's/(user=|token=)[^ ,]+/\1[REDACTED]/g' | head -8 || true
